generation.mode: built-in ImageGen edit with the edit target first and the NinjaOne seed canon second as reference only

lightingIsotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by uniform-bin mean on the delivered source; final water-mask pixels and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lightingIsotropy.visualCheck: No whole-cell sun gradient is obvious, but the basalt bench tops repeatedly read lighter than their vertical faces and multiple conifers retain directional light-dark separation. The aggregate metric cannot override the literal equal-value requirement.

buildableVsSteepFraction.basis: manual estimated fraction of non-water land area at native source resolution
buildableVsSteepFraction.method: The four broad moor bench tops and walkable terrace treads count as buildable; exposed basalt risers and the coastal cliff count as steep; talus, scree, shingle, stream margins, boulders, and conifer stands make up the remainder.

crown.method: Full-image native-resolution dark-green connected-component census of all 118 conifer-shaped crown components, including saplings and edge crowns; median source width 22 px, scaled by 2560/1254 and converted at 0.048 m per final pixel.

waterMask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
waterMask.componentNote: The sea, two descending beck systems, west-edge incoming stream, and small source-painted foam or fall fragments separated by intervening rocks.
waterMask.method: Native-resolution teal-water classification constrained to the three visible stream corridors and the sloped southern coast, expanded through adjacent whitewater, foam, shallow wash, reflections, and ripple highlights; enclosed holes were filled and the full result inspected as a magenta overlay.

refusalReasons: The highest-priority lighting rule fails visually: repeated pale upper planes and darker vertical basalt faces reveal a baked form-light convention, and some conifers retain directional value separation.

Outside the intentionally regular centre-south terrace-steps run, several long bench risers still read as repeated upright column palisades rather than sufficiently broken, leaning, collapsed, and irregular geology.
The southern edge is not entirely open sea: the verified water mask reaches 1108 of 1254 south-edge pixels, leaving a dry south-east corner.
openRisks: The measured crown median is inside the territory band but close to its lower end rather than the requested middle.
The south edge is mostly sea but retains dry shoreline at the extreme south-east corner, so the literal entire-edge sea reading is imperfect.
Exact neighbour-pixel stitch quality and exact water-edge placement remain human visual gates; no artifact was promoted outside quarantine.
